title: CategoryNode - Data API
description: Represents a tree of Solution categories.

ParentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ParentId.description: ID of the parent of this node, if any.

SortOrder.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SortOrder.description: Indicates the sort order of child CategoryNode objects.

SortStyle.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
SortStyle.description: Indicates whether the sort order is alphabetical or custom.

usage:
A CategoryNode defines a category of solutions. In the user interface, you can edit category definitions from Setup by entering Solution Categories in the Quick Find box, then selecting Solution Categories.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<complexType name="CategoryNode">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="MasterLabel" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="ParentId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="SortOrder" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
        <element name="SortStyle" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="SystemModstamp" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
```
